name: Nagasaki Prefecture: ながさき県民参加の森林づくり事業 (forest environment tax subsidy)

funder.name: Nagasaki Prefecture (ながさき森林環境税, Forestry Policy Division)

summary: Subsidy from Nagasaki's forest environment tax for citizen-planned forest work in the prefecture: tree planting, forest upkeep, forest education and satoyama resource conservation. For corporations with a prefectural office and groups of three or more with bylaws.

amount.note: Minimum subsidy; no maximum stated in the guideline

calls.label: Annual plan approval applications

recurring.quote: 計画承認申請書の提出期限は当該年度の11月末日とする。ただし、申請は事業開 始日の1ヶ月前までに行うこととする。

calls.recurring: Plan approval applications are due by the end of November each year, at least a month before the activity starts
